Today's hotfix focuses on performance issues and includes some quality-of-life improvements.
Performance and Stability
● Reduce memory usage of physics assets.
● Adjust Wwise settings for PS5 to prevent crashes.
● Fix hitches associated with death abilities.
● Fix hitches associated with several class abilities.
● Fix hitches associated with exploding barrels.
● Improve performance of animation stance changes.
● Improve cleanup of player character mannequin parts to prevent leaks.
Gameplay
● Fix issue where a reward table roll for some one-time unlocks would not be converted to the alt reward for players that already had the unlock.
● Allow consumable unlocks to work like one-time unlocks for purposes of loot table unlock checks, so that they are not rewarded repeatedly.
UI
● All cutscenes can now be skipped. When in a group, the host has the ability to skip the cutscene for the entire team.
● Fixed audio sometimes dropping for clients after skipping cutscenes.
● Fixed cinematics sometimes display duplicate subtitles.
● The intro cinematic now displays subtitles.
● Fixed audio sometimes dropping for clients after finishing The Reckoning.
● Performance improvements for UI HUD elements during combat. Damage floaters have received significant performance improvements.
Join our Discord for more updates on bug reports and more!

notes.title: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2: Patch #3 Release Notes

items.text: This patch continues our focus on stability and performance, with a large pass on hitching and frame drops across several missions, a round of perk and ability fixes, Horde Mode changes, and a long list of level, audio and UI fixes. We know that there have been a number of issues with rewards; we’ve fixed most of them and will continue to resolve them. As a token of our gratitude for your patience, every player will receive emotes and Halloween decals. Thanks to everyone who has been sending in reports; many of the fixes below came straight from your feedback.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46114117/a4a45f162bcdf4cc2da5e697fb2b035ce75ec2c8.png"]
Items
Fixed an issue where multiple items could be equipped in the players' item slots, rendering them unable to equip major items and inflating their combat rating.
You should now only be able to have one minor item and one major item in each slot.
Added extra collision around item crates to prevent situations which would allow players to get out of the play space.
Fixed medkits disappearing from your inventory after a host migration.
Fixed grenades thrown from cover sometimes hitting the cover.
Perks
Jackpot balance changes

Jackpot was a solid perk in AFE, but the substantial increase of special enemies on higher difficulties, combined with them being overall squishier than AFE makes this powerful effect trigger too often. We still want it to feel good to use but have a lesser effect when triggering from Specials. We may need review this further.
Jackpot works again with heat weapons.
The perk no longer reloads the underbarrel unless that is what you were using
Killing an elite still fully reloads the weapon and dissipates all heat.

notes.title: Killing a Special has the following effects

items.text: Most weaponry: Instant reload of 50% of the magazine's max ammo.
Heat weapons: -25% max heat.
1 Shot weapons (Pike): Triggers full reload every 2 kills.
Drive Perks

Drive and its mods were balanced around a much smaller number of special enemies. While balancing the game with the goal of not making enemies too bullet spongey, we dramatically increased their number. This made Drive scale far too quickly and get to some seriously ridiculous values. We know that some players liked this, but it trivialized build choice and was giving far too much value for its slot size.
Drive now grants 5% cooldown reduction for elite kills, 2% for specials.
Battle Hardened is capped at 25 max health gain and only triggers on elites.
Muscle Memory is capped at 20% max damage and only triggers on elites.
The amount of damage bonus now matches what the tooltip says.
Reaper now restores 5 permanent health for elites, 1 for specials.
This was increased from 2 broadly.
Updated the text and formatting of these to reflect their new mechanics.
Escalating determination now gives you the max hp at the end of each wave instead of the start of each next wave.
Overwhelming Fire now has a cooldown per enemy, not per player.
Fixed weapon training/expertise/mastery perks not affecting weapons correctly.
Fixed different weapons being affected by the wrong perks.
Fixed the M4 Pistol not being affected by handgun perks.
CQW Weapon Training
Fixed it not affecting recoil as much as it should.
Fixed it not affecting the recoil limit, causing recoil to go back to normal over time.
CQW Weapon Expertise
Added overheat speed to its effects.
Fixed it making handling worse for all weapons.
Improved handling bonus from 15% to 20%.
CQW Weapon Mastery
Fixed fire rate being increased but not fire rate limit, causing guns to return to the normal fire rate over time.
Fixed it not affecting spread as much as it should.
Fixed spread being affected incorrectly, where it was reducing minimum and maximum spread instead of minimum spread and spread increase per shot.
Handgun Weapon Training
Changed from increasing weak point damage to increasing stopping power, aiding in the intended gameplay for handguns.
Fixed it not affecting spread as much as it should.
Fixed spread being affected incorrectly, where it was reducing minimum and maximum spread instead of minimum spread and spread increase per shot.
Handgun Weapon Expertise
Fixed fire rate being increased but not fire rate limit, causing guns to return to the normal fire rate over time
Handgun Weapon Mastery
Fixed range not being increased correctly, only affecting near and far ranges.
Fixed aim assist not being affected correctly, only applying a portion of the bonuses and not increasing aim gravity enough so handguns were barely affected.
Added weak point damage and stopping power bonus removed from Weapon Training perk.
Heavy Weapon Training
Added overheat speed effect.
Fixed it decreasing reload speed too much.
Heavy Weapon Expertise
Reduced radius effect from 15% to 10%.
Added stopping power effect.
Fixed it only increasing bullet and projectile damage and not explosion, environmental effect, and over time damage.
Heavy Weapon Mastery
Fixed causing guns to return to the normal fire rate.
Fixed it not affecting the recoil limit, causing recoil to go back to normal over time.
Precision Weapon Training
Fixed it not affecting recoil as much as it should.
Fixed it not affecting the recoil limit, causing recoil to go back to normal over time.
Precision Weapon Expertise
Fixed it making handling worse for all weapons.
Added existing handling bonus to description.
Improved handling bonus from 15% to 20%.
Added weak point stopping power to effects.
Precision Weapon Mastery
Fixed fire rate being increased but not fire rate limit, causing guns to return to the normal fire rate.
Added overheat speed effect.
Rifle Weapon Training
Fixed fire rate being increased but not fire rate limit, causing guns to return to the normal fire rate.
Rifle Weapon Expertise
Fixed range not being increased correctly, only affecting near and far ranges.
Fixed it not affecting recoil as much as it should.
Fixed it not affecting the recoil limit, causing recoil to go back to normal over time.
Rifle Weapon Mastery
Added overheat speed effect.
Fixed it not affecting spread as much as it should.
Fixed spread being affected incorrectly, where it was reducing minimum and maximum spread instead of minimum spread and spread increase per shot.
Classes
Specialist
Unyielding now grants the full health bonus listed in its description.
Hard to Hit now grants 20% damage resistance after dodging, instead of 100%.
Duelist
Fixed the Remote Detonator doing double friendly fire damage.
Machinist
Hyperlocal Logistics now increases turret health regen by 10% as described, instead of doubling it.
The Rumble Turret is now the correct size.
Fixed Rumble Turret radius and fire rate to appear accurately for clients.
Marauder
The Minefield perk no longer prevents you from manually launching remote mines when first equipped.
The Minefield perk no longer forces players out of aim down sights.
Fixed the Breaching Blast icon on enemy health bars.
Hunter
Made sure the beams only hit players if friendly fire is enabled and the players are hit directly.
Friendlies are no longer counted in the near-miss or point-blank beam code.
Particle Pulse ability buffed to make it more viable.
Damage increased from maximum of 800 -> 1000.
Stopping Power increased from a maximum of 600 -> 750.
Ability friendly fire behavior fixed so it's working correctly and reliably.
Maximum charge time reduced from 2 -> 1.5 seconds.
AoE Damage from the explosion increased from 200 -> 300.
AoE Stopping Power from the explosion increased from 300 -> 400.
AoE Radius from the explosion increased from 300 -> 400.
Fixed the ability not working to blow up explosive barrels or mines.
Supercharged perk now increases charge time by 20% instead of 50% to make it more viable.
Challenge Cards
Challenge cards no longer deactivate for remaining players after a host migration.
Misc
Players now play the correct grapple animation when grabbed while crouched in cover.
Weapons
Fixed the F44AA stock ADS animation not replicating to clients.
Fixed the front hand not gripping the shotgun properly.
Adjusted the player’s hand grip on the Revolver Rifle.
Underbarrels
The HUD ammo counter now turns red when your underbarrel is out of ammo.
Fixed the HUD showing your gun as out of ammo while using an underbarrel that still has ammo.
Mondo Heat 9000
Fixed the muzzle flash staying red with the Cryo Ammunition augment equipped.
Augments
Fixed the thermal beam augment for the Type 111 causing the beam damage to last indefinitely.
Removed the extra 20 DPS fire DOT from the augment because it would retrigger and reapply itself.
Added 10% Stopping Power buff to the augment to replace the lost DPS.
Fixed damage over time guns removing the wrong DOT from enemies if that DOT was applied by that weapon previously, causing the weapon’s DOT to last indefinitely.
The Kramer Short Barrel Electric Ammo augment now shows electric effects.
Bonuses that occur on Empty Magazines are only working for the host, not for other players.
Stuck Enemies & Behavior
Further fixes for enemies climbing surfaces at the wrong angle, clipping into geometry, and getting stuck there.
Fixed Xenos getting stuck under the floor in “Sleep Study”.
Fixed the Crusher getting stuck behind a door in “Bomb Squad”.
Fixed Enforcers falling off of catwalks in “Bomb Squad”.
Fixed the Warden becoming stuck and unresponsive in the corners of the room in “Power Problems".
Flamer synths now engage players properly instead of waiting until you get close.
Enemies can no longer open locked doors in the Underbelly finale.
Enemies can no longer be knocked through walls in “Piping Hot”.
Fixed Xenos appearing to come out of rubble in “Running on Fumes".
Deaths & Visuals
Fixed enemies sometimes flying across the screen on death for clients.
Fixed the Pathogen Brute sometimes floating in the air after being killed.
Fixed incorrect gibs on the Synth Detonator and Synth Enforcer.
The death splat has been updated for certain enemies, and blood no longer splashes everywhere when shot.
Death decals from Bulwarks and Crawlers no longer appear on players.
Clients now see the dust and smoke effects when enemies spawn.
Fixed some instances of companion bots not attempting to revive the player.
Fixed companion bots getting stuck in an A-pose when switching weapons.
We apologize for all the issues that players experienced with rewards, we have more fixes planned for future updates but we addressed the following:
We fixed an issue where rewards were being cleared from memory, causing them to be lost instead of rewarded.
Emotes had a specific issue that prevented them from being rewarded.
It will still occasionally try to give you rewards you already have which results in no rewards, this will be fixed in the next update.
Completing the Queen Fight mission at times will not reward you properly.
We are still looking into fixing APEsuit Mk.IV Helmet and the Torso/Legs so they can be delivered correctly upon reaching wave 50 in horde mode.
Players will receive new Halloween specific decals as compensation for the inconvenience this issue has caused.
Unlock crates now primarily give you gameplay rewards instead of only cosmetics.
Augments, Major items and some perks will only drop on intense or higher difficulty but can still be purchased in the store.
Fixed incorrect unlock crates appearing in some missions.
Horde Mode
Horde Mode is now available immediately for new characters and has been unlocked for existing characters.
Updated Horde Mode lifetime stats to be more relevant.
Clients can now see the grinder animations on the Horde Mode map.
Rewards & Unlocks
Emotes found in Hidden Caches are now added to your inventory.
Reward notifications now still appear if you close the post-mission screen with ESC.
Fixed a Hidden Cache in “Synth Headache” that didn’t work like other caches.
Mission Fixes
Fixed progression blockers in “Sleep Study” and “Power Problems” that occurred after a host migration.
Fixed a case where the finale couldn’t be triggered because a player got stuck.
In the mission “Breaking and Entering” the final encounter can no longer start while a player is still above, and players can no longer interact through a door.
Fixed an instance of the gate not opening during a “hold the landing pad” event.
Fixed a door in “Piping Hot” that could open into nowhere when an enemy was nearby.
The intel terminal encounter in “Deadly Descendants” now starts when you engage with the terminal instead of after crossing the bridge,
Adjusted the “Power Problems” finale battle with better pacing and more enemy variety.
The Find Administrator Office objective in “Breaking and Entering” now asks you to clear hostiles first.
Horde Mode
Clients can now see the grinder animations on the Horde Mode map.
Story & Hub
Piper now animates and speaks in person during her rescue instead of only over the radio.
Removed a long pause between voice lines in the final scene of “Piping Hot”.
Fixed one of Wrench’s lines playing twice in a row after “Power Problems”.
Esther no longer appears in the Hub before “Synth Headache” is complete.
Your active Hub objective now shows again after quitting and reloading.
NPCs’ lips no longer keep moving after skipping through a conversation.
Added skip options in two hub conversations in which they were missing.
General Improvements
Adjusted collision in several Missions and Horde Mode maps to prevent players from getting stuck or exiting the gameplay space.
Several asset adjustments in environments to fix areas where the player could see through the level.
General improvements to asset LODs to prevent visual inconsistency.
Updates to address decal artifacts, incorrect materials, and misplaced props throughout the Missions.
Adjusted the location of intel, credit crates, and pickup items so they are no longer hidden in the environment.
Adjustments to level streaming in “Rescue and Recovery”, “Boarding Party”, “Rock Bottom”, and “Ancient Anomaly” to prevent seeing assets unloaded.
Fixed the camera clipping into walls in “Canyon Crawlers” and “Muthur May I”.
Improved the steam, smoke and dust VFX in “Bomb Squad”, “Rescue and Recovery”, and ‘Running on Fumes”.
Fixed a visibility issue with the dropship during the second bombing run in “Breaking and Entering”.
Fixed flickering on the floor near Wrench in the Hub.
Fixed a “Restricted Area” sign typo in “Breaking and Entering”.
Optimized network bandwidth usage.
Fixed missing or swapped character models and names in the Ready Up screen and the post-game screen when players join or leave.
“Banshee Down”, “Reckoning” and the finale have been removed from the Quickplay mission pool.
HUD position settings now support a wider range resolution ratios.
Augments previewed in the Collection menu now show their Advanced details by default.
Added a Resistance entry to Enemies in Lifetime Stats.
Updated loading screen tips for accuracy.
Added a purchase confirmation popup when buying from Wrench’s shop on consoles and removed an extra confirmation prompt from the store popup.
Headgear no longer disappears in the major/minor items screen.
Fixed the Region text being angled incorrectly.
Character creation now includes darker skin tone options.
Colorways no longer tint Ripley and Rain shoes.
The “Stripes, Orange” decal now matches its name.
Fixed decals showing an edge line when scaled to minimum size.
Fixed a visible seam on heads, Hair #9 floating above the head, and Male Head #6 clipping through the APEsuit helmet.
Fixed holes and stretching on several armor pieces, including the Armat SF1, Mondo Pest Jumper, Weyland-Yutani Light, 3WE Mk. IV Heavy and default Duelist armor.
Fixed the Ski Goggles strap not fitting the head properly.
NPC and Player Voiceover now properly ducks the music volume.
Fixed first-person weapon firing sounds cutting out during heavy combat.
Weapon fire audio now correctly represents fire rates when they increase or decrease as a result of modifications, traits, perks, abilities, etc. (including Medic’s Overclock).
Automatic weapon firing sfx will no longer loop endlessly after changing fire rates while firing.
Player voiceover lines for pinging ammo boxes and health packs now play more consistently.
Player voiceover when being grappled by the harbinger now trigger with the intended timing.
Instances of mission music not transitioning properly at mission end have been corrected.
Added missing sounds to unlock crates, the “Power Problems” generator room flames, and the valve interaction.
Hidden caches now emit a looping sfx.
Updated the explosion sound in “Sleep Study” if players fail the mission.
Selected player voiceover “barks” have been added back into gameplay.
Optimization pass across Colony levels to reduce hitching.
Fixed the game freezing for several seconds when certain enemies spawned.
Reduced instances of hitching and frame drops during combat.
Reduced hitching for clients when opening doors in “Bomb Squad”.
Fixed the host hitching when a hidden crate is opened.
Fixed a large frame-rate drop when using Explosive Rounds on the Duelist.
Reduced hitching in Breaking and Entering and “Power Problems”.
Fixed crashes when inviting a player and matchmaking in Quickplay, and after accepting an invite.
Fixed a crash for clients when swapping perks and backing out of the menu.
Fixed crashes during missions in “Power Problems”, “Sleep Study” and “Banshee Down”.
Translated the error message shown when trying to join while already in a game.
Localized text in the loading screen frame.
Fixed the Tab key label not being translated in Korean controller settings.
Fixed Spanish wall text overlapping the art in the Prologue.
There are still instances of enemies visibly spawning in.
Horde Mode will still occasionally try to give you rewards you already have which results in no rewards, this will be fixed in the next update.
Xbox Series X|S Updates
The game’s crossplay setting now matches your Xbox account setting on startup.
PlayStation 5 Updates
Audio recordings, such as Dr. Pierce’s, now play at the same volume as character dialogue.
Epic Games Store Updates
Fixed achievement pop-ups displaying incorrectly in Traditional Chinese and Korean.
Join our Discord for more updates on bug reports and more!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46114117/3d5066b932e101342188cdef1336aea30dbdfa5d.png"]

Thank you for your patience. This latest patch focuses on stability, performance, and addressing critical issues. We made additional improvements to reduce instances of stutter and crashing in the game. We are continuously working to address further performance issues across all platforms, and we will continue to monitor feedback and release additional patches in the coming weeks.

notes.title: Some notable fixes in today’s update include

items.text: Added general framerate optimizations and improved performance.
Addressed multiple instances of item pick-up issues with ammo boxes and med kits.
Additional Audio optimizations - including reduced audio bark frequency, increased variety and voice over line adjustments
Fixed an issue where players were dying and losing rewards after the Queen had already been defeated.
Fixed several broken doors, checkpoints and triggers that blocked mission progression.
Fixed Horde Mode reward tables not granting rewards after wave 50.
Fixed a few cases of items/rewards displaying the wrong unlock requirements.
Fixed an issue where Bots blocked progression doors from unlocking further parts of a mission if they get unexpectedly stuck.
Arrow keys can now be rebound on PC platforms.
These and more. Read on for the full list of fixes.
General
Interaction Bug
Fixed the issue where clients were often unable to interact (grab ammo, pickup items & med kits or interact with consoles) until they reloaded their weapon.
Interact is now prioritized instead of reload when both options are present (e.g. you’re able to interact with something and pick it up / get its benefit).
Note: Other interaction issues may persist and will be addressed in future updates.
Perks
Fixed several perks and challenge cards not properly crediting kills or applying their bonuses (Gunslinger, Gravity Vortex/Well, Dual Targeting, Electrified, Coordinated Assault II, and others).
Corrected numerous perk, augment, and item tooltips that were showing the wrong values or descriptions.
Heavy Rounds combat rating changed from 45 -> 30 to match its perk size (should be 15 per slot).
Player Character
Fix for dodge rolls feeling unresponsive and potentially not rolling in the correct direction.
Fixed environmental and friendly damage-over-time fields (poison/fire) continuing to hurt players and companion bots after they'd left the area.
Machinist
Fixed an issue where the bodyguard stopped following the player.
Bodyguards should attack targets more reliably.
Turrets and bodyguards deployed by the Machinist now prioritize targets pinged by their owner.
Fixed an issue where in multiplayer, several duplicate voice lines would play when deploying turrets.
Hunter
The Focused Shot: Legs perk incorrectly stated it slowed by 20% instead of 40%.
The Focused Shot: Arms perk incorrectly stated it reduced melee damage by 20% instead of 40%.
Inverted Bolt perk now makes players faster while in the radius as well as enemies.
Arc Bolt now correctly counts kills from the ability towards perks and passive abilities such as Gunslinger.
Fixed Bolt ammo perks not correctly changing the max ammo for clients.
Removed incorrect tooltips from Particle and Cryo Pulse abilities.
Medic
Host is no longer permanently immune to poison damage.
Fixed the poison station doing 4x friendly fire damage.
NOTE: We are looking at changes to make the poison and buff station more viable and drain slower, so look for updates to these in the future.
Duelist
Fixed Gun and Launcher ammo perks not correctly changing the max ammo for clients.
Cover
Should attach less frequently to cover when moving beside it instead of into it.
Throwing grenades from low cover should have a more accurate preview and not explode on the cover you’re throwing it from (unless you aimed it there).
Cryo effects
Lowered the overall duration of cryo effects on players by increasing the decay rate and reducing the decay delay.

Fixed cryo decay being paused by cryo effects when a character is thawing after being frozen and left unshattered, which allowed players to effectively lock enemies in an extended cryo state unintentionally.
Fixed cryo behavior so enemies can only be slowed up to their slow limit when thawing.
Fixed some cryo weapons being unable to damage enemies when they are thawing.
Challenge Cards
Fixed Hold the Line challenge card allowing players to move in ADS if they use underbarrel guns.
Fix for Coordinated Assault II not requiring the correct damage values.
Weapons & Attachments
Weapons
General
Fixed ammo counts getting out of sync between host and other players.
Fixed a laser sight showing up in the wrong position on some weapons.
Fixed issue where players hand would not properly grip the shotgun.
Fixed damage over time weapons automatically reloading when the auto reload setting is turned off.
Fixed weapon overheat status text getting stuck on screen after switching weapons.
Fixed firemode indicators not updating when swapping weapons or classes.
Underbarrels
Fixed underbarrel guns being unaffected by perkboard perks.
Fixed underbarrel guns being unaffected by challenge cards.
Fixed the Classic Pulse Rifle Underbarrel animation looping incorrectly.
Weapons now automatically swap to/from an underbarrel attachment when it runs empty if the “automatically swap when empty” setting is enabled and the other firemode still has ammo.
Firemodes can now be switched mid-reload, cancelling the reload instead of being blocked by it.
Switching firemodes to or from an underbarrel with no ammo will now trigger a reload if the auto reload setting is on.
Fixed underbarrel guns triggering the consumable ammo effects on their parent gun instead of using their own.
Fixed underbarrel ammo icons always being a rocket instead of matching the underbarrel type.
Revolvers
Fixed reloads causing muzzles to float on the Frontier Revolver.
Fixed revolver and revolver rifle cylinders animating out too far.
Fixed the Frontier Revolver cylinder not rotating correctly during reloads.
Spread increase while moving reduced on the revolver rifle to make it more viable to use while moving.
Mondo Heat 9000
Fixed the Mondo Heat underbarrel launcher being able to use consumable ammo and the explosions not dealing thermal damage.
Fixed the Mondo Heat 9000 gun trait causing reloads triggered by consumable ammo to be 20% slower.
The Mondo Heat underbarrel now properly displays as thermal type.
Attachments
Regulating armature can no longer cause negative move speed, which would make players move backwards when holding forward.
Enemies
Stuck Enemies

Many fixes went in to address enemies getting stuck via navigation / pathfinding and from their AI getting stuck in a bad state. Our work here is ongoing, as there are still cases of being stuck that require different fixes.
Most enemies should no longer get stuck inside walls after being knocked back, though we still have cases of enemies getting stuck in objects outside of this we're looking into.
Enemies no longer get stuck in a bad state when taking reactions, especially heavier elemental reactions.
General
Fixed an issue on clients in which the forces on enemies were too high, causing them to slide forward or shoot up with very high values.
Reduced the instances of enemy corpses hanging from the ceiling.
Enemy ragdolls should be more synchronized between hosts and clients.
Improved the visuals of enemies moving on slopped surfaces.
Grapple
Clients no longer have a more difficult minigame to break free of grapples.
Queen
Fixed an issue where players were still dying and losing rewards after the Queen had already been defeated.
She can no longer be frozen as easily and thaws out faster once frozen.
Siren
Siren motion tracker dot now disappears correctly after death.
Synth Sniper
Snipers must now spend their entire aim time on the target before firing. This prevents them from quickscoping and firing on new targets immediately if they lost their old target.
Synth Troopers
Increased detection range to prevent them from standing around without engaging.
Turrets
Fixed the deploy and deactivate animation states of the turret.
Fixed turrets shooting from below the muzzle, which offset their aim.
Harbinger
Now correctly leaps at players with its leaping attack.
Engineer Husk
Nameplate health bar no longer stays on the screen indefinitely.
Slam now deals damage properly at its end.
Spore Thrower
No longer teleports to its left when being electrocuted.
Brute
Fixed some instances of the Brute floating in the air upon dying.
Gasbag
Correct gibs and FX now play if killed by cryo damage or when frozen.
Companions
Fixed downed teammates being knocked out of their “incapacitated” reaction animation by an ally's ability.
AI companions will now break from cover and reposition once it's no longer protecting them.
Fixed AI teammates occasionally getting stuck thinking a path was blocked and refusing to move.
Fixed downed AI teammates sometimes staying still even after being revived.
Companions (including the deployable turret) now respond properly when you ping an enemy for them to attack.
Missions & Progression
Fixed several broken doors, checkpoints, and triggers that could block mission progress, especially after a host migration.
Trimmed some repetitive chatter.
Fixed a few cases of items/rewards displaying the wrong unlock requirements.
Fixed mission-select screens showing the wrong enemy types for a couple of missions.
Mission difficulty descriptions now note that Friendly Fire is active on higher difficulties.
Bots are no longer blocking progression doors from unlocking further parts of a mission if they get unexpectedly stuck.
Fixed Horde Mode reward tables not granting rewards after wave 50.
Horde Mode wave 50 rewards should now grant both the helmet and outfit instead of only 1 of 2.
Added XP and credit rewards to Horde Mode that increase every 5 waves up until wave 100.
+500 from waves 5-25
+1000 from waves 30-100

We have a suspected fix for players not getting rewards they should have. Now when you load up, the game will check if you SHOULD have gotten a reward for weapons, class, player rank, etc. and attempt to reward you with it. We've attempted to resolve this issue, but there may still be situations that you encounter it. We welcome your feedback if you're still encountering this issue.
Levels & World
Closed off dozens of spots across nearly every level where players could climb, clip, or slip outside the intended play area.
Fixed numerous geometry gaps that let you see outside the level.
Fixed visual pop-in on distant scenery, railings, and walkways in several areas.
Fixed floating/clipping props (barrels, foliage, pipes, decals, crates) throughout multiple levels.
Fixed enemies spawning underneath the floor in a couple of spots.
Fixed one enemy spawn point releasing enemies without their spawn animation playing.
Added a waypoint to reduce confusion after a certain point in the Colony mission.
Multiplayer & Online
Fixed muted teammates showing as unmuted again after leaving and rejoining a lobby.
Fixed your mic appearing active during push-to-talk when it wasn't.
Fixed matchmaking and crossplay settings resetting unexpectedly.
Fixed disconnecting while queuing not resetting your online status properly.
Fixed host not earning mission rewards if they are spectating when the mission completes.
Fixed a “reconnect” prompt incorrectly appearing for solo players.
Removed the “Leave Group” option from the post-game screen.
UI & Menus
Fixed dropdowns appearing behind popups and tooltips.
Fixed the Settings option missing from the title screen on console platforms.
Fixed selecting an Outfit Color switching to the Legs tab.
Fixed the Collection screen item count including items you don't actually own.
Fixed the Emotes screen sometimes showing an empty list.
The “abandon mission” prompt now requires a hold instead of a quick tap, and only appears in multiplayer.
Fixed ESC not backing out of Settings when opened from the title screen.
Fixed a title-screen intro video restarting repeatedly under certain conditions.
Arrow keys can now be rebound.
Audio
Player and NPC guns firing sfx volume, when heard in third person, has been adjusted and improved.
Game audio now plays as intended after certain cutscenes.
Weapon overheat sfx no longer cutoff prematurely.
Added and adjusted several musical stingers to punctuate gameplay and spooky moments across missions.
Reduced the overall frequency of some player barks.
Reduced on-kill bark chance based on the number of human players so they don't become 2-4x as common.
Performance
Performance passes across early levels to reduce stuttering.
General framerate and hitching improvements.
Fixed a rare bug that could cause the game to render at a fraction of your screen resolution.
Localization & Credits
Imported updated translations across multiple languages, including new Traditional Chinese and Korean localization.
Corrected several names and titles in the credits.
A fix that was made in this update has broken the Collection screen such that the count now reads "owned/owned" instead of the intended "owned/total.” We will fix this in the next update.
Join our Discord for more updates on bug reports and more!

Horde Mode is now available immediately for new characters and has been unlocked for existing characters.
Updated Horde Mode lifetime stats to be more relevant.
Clients can now see the grinder animations on the Horde Mode map.
Rewards & Unlocks
Emotes found in Hidden Caches are now added to your inventory.
Reward notifications now still appear if you close the post-mission screen with ESC.
Fixed a Hidden Cache in “Synth Headache” that didn’t work like other caches.
There are still instances of enemies visibly spawning in.
Horde Mode will still occasionally try to give you rewards you already have which results in no rewards, this will be fixed in the next update.
